content.title: Your Salesmessage onboarding journey
content.summary: What to expect from sign-up to sending your first text as an organization, so there are no surprises and you go live faster. Every business must be registered and approved before a single message can send.

sections.heading: Read this first
sections.body: U.S. and Canadian carriers regulate business texting to stop spam. You can't send texts or calls until your business is registered and approved by the carriers (10DLC or Toll-Free). We prepare and submit this for you, but the final approval is controlled by the carriers. It usually takes several business days and occasionally longer.

sections.heading: The five stages at a glance
Stage 1: Welcome & kickoff
sections.body: You sign up and are matched with an Onboarding Manager and, depending on your plan, a dedicated Customer Success Manager. We hold a kickoff call to understand your goals, how you'll use texting, and your target go-live date. Attend the kickoff and come ready to share:
bullets: How many users and phone numbers you need
When you'd like to be live

rows.label: Done when
rows.value: You've had your kickoff call and a recap with your onboarding plan and timeline.

sidebar.heading: At a glance

facts.label: Training
facts.value: 1:1 admin session plus a group session

sidebar.callout_title: The biggest way to go live faster
sidebar.callout_text: Get us your business details early and accurate. See the prep checklist at the end.

sections.heading: Stage 2: Compliance & registration
sections.body: We register your business with the carriers so your texts are trusted and actually get delivered. There are two paths, and we'll tell you which one fits: 10DLC (for local numbers) or Toll-Free Verification (for toll-free numbers, and the only option for Canadian numbers). We prepare, submit, and manage the entire carrier review for you.

sections.heading: What you'll need ready
sections.body: This is what speeds everything up.
bullets: Legal business name and EIN / Tax ID, exactly matching your IRS records
A website with a Privacy Policy (including SMS consent language) and Terms
A compliant opt-in method: web form, paper form, text-to-join keyword, or QR code
A clear description of what you'll text, plus a couple of sample messages

rows.label: Done when
rows.value: Your Brand and Campaign are approved and sending is unlocked on your account.

sections.heading: Stage 3: Account setup
sections.body: We configure your account so it's ready for your whole team. Much of this runs in parallel with compliance.
bullets: Phone numbers & inboxes: new local numbers, or transfer, port, or host yours
Users: mapped to inboxes, with assignment rules and business hours
Roles & permissions: the right people have the right access
Integrations: your CRM (e.g. HubSpot) and tools like Aircall or RingCentral

rows.label: What you'll do
rows.value: Confirm users, numbers, and integrations. We set them up and send a test message.

rows.label: Done when
rows.value: Numbers, users, and integrations are live and a test message sends successfully.

sidebar.heading: Compliance timing
sidebar.callout_text: Approval is decided by the carriers, not by Salesmessage. It is not guaranteed and not same-day. If anything is rejected, we tell you what to fix and resubmit it for you. No messages can be sent until this is approved.

sections.heading: Stage 4: Training
sections.body: We train your team so adoption actually sticks. This includes a 1:1 admin training session and a group session for your users, covering 1:1 texting, broadcasts, tags, contacts, and calling, plus a walkthrough of your CRM integration and SMS best practices.

rows.label: Done when
rows.value: Your admins and users have been trained and have their recap resources and recording.

sections.heading: Stage 5: Go-live & ongoing support
sections.body: You launch. We check in the morning of go-live to make sure everyone's set, then follow up about two weeks later to clear any blockers and confirm the KPIs you're measuring success by.

rows.label: What you'll do
rows.value: Start texting with confidence; loop in your Customer Success team for anything you need.

rows.label: Done when
rows.value: You're live, measured, and on a regular check-in cadence.

rows.label: Why not text right away?
rows.value: Carriers require registration to fight spam. Until you're approved, they block business texts.

rows.label: How long is compliance?
rows.value: Carriers control final approval, usually several business days. Page 2 shows what affects it.

rows.label: Anything different in Canada?
rows.value: Yes. Canadian numbers must use Toll-Free Verification; 10DLC isn't available.

rows.label: Keep our existing numbers?
rows.value: In most cases, yes. Numbers can be transferred, ported, or hosted during Account Setup.

sidebar.callout_text: A weekly live webinar series and our Help Center are there whenever you need them.

cta.headline: Not sure where you are in the process?
cta.text: Your Onboarding Manager or Customer Success team can tell you exactly which stage you're in.
